Follows this phone, so scheduled times read the same everywhere.
Which website opens profile and note links when no Nostr app on this phone handles them.
Copying a note\'s text is always available on its page. The networks below are optional.
Adds a button to every post that opens x.com with the note already written.
Facebook takes no text from a link: the button shares the note into the Facebook app, or — when that app is not installed — copies it and opens Facebook to paste.
LinkedIn takes no text from a link either: the button shares the note into the LinkedIn app, or — when that app is not installed — copies it and opens LinkedIn to paste.
These relays will receive every post you publish, in addition to each account\'s NIP-65 write relays.
Log out of Emanator on this phone? Your posts and schedule stay on the server.
Media servers keep exactly the bytes they receive, so photos are shrunk before they leave your browser or phone. Re-encoding also removes location and camera metadata.
Screenshots and images with transparency stay lossless PNG. Animated GIFs are uploaded as they are.
Videos become MP4 (H.264) at no more than 30 frames per second, without location or camera metadata. If the phone cannot re-encode a video, the original is uploaded.
Phones signed in to the Emanator app. Signing one out here ends its session immediately.
Signing out this device logs you out of the app.
Connect an AI agent to Emanator over the Model Context Protocol. Point your MCP client at %1$s and send the token as \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\".

A token can post as you. It reads your accounts and posts, creates drafts, and schedules posts that are then signed and published automatically under any of your paired identities, without a further approval step — because your signer approves kind-1 notes without prompting. Treat a token like a posting key: hand it only to an agent you would let speak as these accounts, and revoke it here the moment you stop trusting it.
